boards.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit target / identity reference: approved GeoGuard batch-06-cannon-sniper.png. Create a NEW production specification board preserving exactly the two existing identities, colors, soft brown outlines, sage green fill, anatomy and three-quarter orthographic camera. NOT a redesign.
Landscape cream board: upper row CANNON, lower row SNIPER. Each row has four equally sized local body-only pose cells in order NEUTRAL / SQUASH / STRETCH / ATTACK. Put clear row names and small cell titles. Four ROOT crosses per row, exact same local horizontal position, all on a shared horizontal dashed ground baseline THROUGH THE BOTTOMS OF BOTH PLANTED FEET, with ROOT text below. Cross is at midpoint of the two foot contacts, not below feet. No shadows in main cells. Feet keep same root center. Squash and stretch affect only body soft tissue, never translate whole character; ATTACK small local compression/recovery, no horizontal recoil. Keep foot roots fixed even if body leans.
CANNON preserves reference broad round sage body, existing upper/rear bud silhouette and rear contour, two short feet, exactly one near-side brown eye and the same large barrel mouth. No new cheek, smile, face or organ. The one large barrel is rigid, constant aperture and cross-section in all four poses, mounted at fixed body attachment P; body deformation does NOT scale the barrel. No extra gun.
SNIPER preserves continuous long-neck pear body, two short feet, exactly two small neck-top eyes, one single slender tapered beak extending right and exactly one dark-brown belly pad. No extra mouth or buds. Single beak is separately riggable but its drawn junction remains continuously connected to neck; rigid beak length/shape not squash-stretched, only body neck compresses/extends.
Separate compact bottom construction strip, clearly outside the body cells: labeled CANNON P/M and SNIPER P/M detached launcher profiles, an axis arrow on each, generic layer text 'SOFT BODY + FACE / FEET / RIGID LAUNCHER / SHADOW'. P is launcher attachment, M is aperture/beak outlet. Draw only the existing launcher forms, not projectiles. Include text 'PROPOSED ANCHORS / NOT MEASURED' and 'FIXED ROOT / LOCAL DEFORMATION'.
Absolute avoid in ALL BODY CELLS: bullets, flying objects, muzzle flashes, trajectory lines, recoil ticks, speed lines, motion strokes, dust, other characters. No character x-position drift. Do not change pose camera to frontal. Cream whitespace, minimal clear brown technical annotations, tasteful soft sticker illustration matching source. Main cells are body-only design keyposes, not sprite atlas.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: fixed-root body-only production specification board.
Edit target / identity reference: approved GeoGuard batch-07-rail-rapid-v2.png. Preserve EXACT approved RAIL upper row and RAPID lower row anatomy, colors, silhouette topology and camera. New landscape cream board with two rows, four equal cells per row: NEUTRAL / SQUASH / STRETCH / ATTACK. Clean soft sage sticker characters, warm brown contours, same three-quarter orthographic view.
All four feet per row align to same dashed horizontal ground baseline THROUGH LOWEST OUTLINE OF BOTH PLANTED FEET. One ROOT cross midway between the two foot contacts in each cell, ON that line, text ROOT below. Same local x-root across cells; no horizontal recoil. No main-cell shadows. Squash/stretch deform soft body only, fixed feet center. ATTACK is small local compression/recovery without body translation.
RAIL: continuous long-neck pear sage body, exactly two small brown neck-top eyes, two short feet, ONE darker sage belly pad and EXACTLY TWO equal parallel long thin beaks/tubes extending right. Their common rigid mount must remain attached smoothly at head/neck. Both rigid tubes maintain their own equal length, bore size, separation and parallelism across all four poses. No third tube, no extra muzzle, no new cheek/mouth. Do not convert into separate head or realistic machinery.
RAPID: round sage body, exactly two top buds, one rear/left short petal, two short feet, one near-side eye, one curved cheek/smile, exactly TWO short rounded cylindrical tubes stacked vertically at upper-right body. Rigid two-tube group keeps aperture size, lengths and spacing in every pose, independent of body scale; attached to one common body mount. No extra dots, buds, feet, face or tubes.
Below main rows, separate compact construction strip outside body cells: 'RAIL P / M1 / M2' and 'RAPID P / M1 / M2' detached rigid launcher diagrams; P body root, M1 upper outlet center, M2 lower outlet center; axis arrow +X only here. Text 'SOFT BODY + FACE / FEET / RIGID LAUNCHER / SHADOW', 'PROPOSED ANCHORS / NOT MEASURED', 'ONE LOGIC SHOT / PIPE COUNT IS ANATOMY'.
Remove ALL reference bullets, muzzle flashes, trajectory dashes, motion ticks, speed marks from EVERY body cell. Body cells contain only attached character anatomy and root annotation. No other characters. No new design, no frontal camera, no detached body beak, no photoreal 3D. Existing soft body deformation is allowed; rigid launchers are not scaled. Specification artwork, not animation atlas.
boards.targetedRepair:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY anchor annotations on supplied RAIL/RAPID production sheet, preserve every character pose, organ, color, outline and all other text.
In the two lower construction diagrams, P currently sits in the BELLY; this is wrong. ERASE both belly P crosses/letters. Place each new P at the BODY SURFACE WHERE THE TWO-TUBE LAUNCHER GROUP ATTACHES: RAIL on the right edge of HEAD/NECK midway between upper and lower tube roots, RAPID on the upper-right body edge midway between two tube roots. Add small dot and leader labeled P at that attachment point. The two detached tubes connect to this body-surface P via dotted construction leaders. P is the tube-group mount, not body center and not foot root.
For every main cell, move only ROOT cross a few pixels UP onto its existing dashed ground baseline so cross is at foot-contact height, not below line; labels remain below. No art redesign, no change to body or rigid tubes. Preserve no-projectiles body-only cells, two eyes RAIL and one eye RAPID.
